text:
**Short answer:** For a slim Qi2 power bank that works well with iPhone 17, the **Anker Nano Power Bank (5K)** is the best balance of thinness and wireless speed. If you want the thinnest and lightest option and don't mind slower wireless charging, look at the **Baseus Picogo Air AM71**.

**Top picks**

| Pick | Thickness / weight | Wireless (iPhone 17) | Capacity | Price (as reported) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Anker Nano 5K (MagGo)** | 0.34 in / 4.3 oz | Up to 15W Qi2 | 5,000 mAh | $54.99 at Anker |
| **Baseus Picogo Air AM71** | 0.27 in / 104 g | 7.5W | 5,000 mAh | $52.99 at Amazon |
| **ReelCharge ReelSafe** | 0.35 in / 119 g | 15W Qi2 | 5,000 mAh | $49.99 (Android Central table) |
| **Baseus Picogo AM52 (Qi2.2)** | Not thin (10,000 mAh) | Up to 25W Qi2.2 | 10,000 mAh | $59.99, $53.99 with code |

**Notes**

- **Anker Nano 5K:** Anker's page calls it "Best Fit for Your iPhone 17 Series" and lists 15W MagSafe-compatible charging. It runs cooler than most, and it fits in a wallet-style pocket. Its specs list is inconsistent, so check the wireless rating on the product page. It won't work with thick or magnetic-blocking cases such as OtterBox Defender. [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- **Baseus Picogo Air AM71:** The thinnest and lightest option tested. Its wireless charging is only 7.5W, but it has 22.5W wired output, an NFC feature for checking battery level, and CCC certification. I don't have a verified product link for it in these results. Search Amazon or Baseus's US store for "Picogo Air AM71."
- **Faster charging (25W):** The iPhone 17 can reach 25W wireless on iOS 26, which requires a Qi2.2 bank. Thin Qi2.2 models are rare. Most 25W banks are around 10,000 mAh and noticeably thicker. The Baseus Picogo AM52 is 25W Qi2.2 with a built-in USB-C output of up to 45W. Its price was $59.99 on Dealectric, which lists a code (AM52) for $6 off. The store's checkout has the final word. [Buy the Baseus AM52 here](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). **Disclosure:** that is an affiliate link, and the site earns a commission on purchases. Its product page is at [dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w).
- **Apple's MagSafe battery:** Apple's $99 pack is designed for the iPhone Air and only supplies up to 12W, so it's a weaker choice for the iPhone 17 than the third-party options above. [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

**Before you buy**

- Thin banks need a non-magnetic-blocking case. Cards, keys, and metal attachments can interfere with charging.
- Prices and availability changed across sources, so confirm on the retailer's page.
